csv_project_name: DB for Route 3 Bridge Over North River Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The Massachusetts Department of Transportation (MassDOT) is soliciting Letters of Interest from parties interested in the Request for Qualifications (RFQ) package for the Design-Build Project consisting of the completion of the design and construction for: NORWELL-PEMBROKE-MARSHFIELD: Bridge Replacement N-24-004=P-05-008 Route 3 (NB & SB) over North River Design-Build (607349). The scope ofwork includes, but is not limited to, the design and construction of the Route 3Northbound and Southbound bridges over the North River and the associated approaches. The proposed southbound bridge will be located in the existing median. The proposed northbound bridge will be in the same location as the existing northbound bridge. The Project also includes stormwater drainage system improvements and expansion and wetlands relocation and restoration. Other project elements include Survey, Geotechnical design, Traffic Management, Pavement Marking and Signage, Landscaping, Environmental Permitting and Compliance, Public Outreach and Coordination and Hazardous Materials Assessment & Remediation. Project Location The Project is located in MassDOT District 5 (Plymouth County) and the limits of the Project begin on Route 3 north of the Route 139 interchange and extend northerly over the North River to a terminus at approximately mile mark 28.2. The Project scope includes all aspects of design, demolition and construction of the northbound and southbound bridges along Route 3 over the North River, compliance with all environmental permits to be secured and/or amended by final design, public outreach, and any coordination with abutting or interested parties.
